verdict.rationale: BigQuery's docs say the sandbox lets you use BigQuery without a credit card or billing account, at no cost, to check whether it fits your needs (docs-62, docs-6, docs-73, docs-48). The free allowance of 10 GiB storage and 1 TiB of queries per month supports real queries on real data (docs-83, docs-19). Missing for 10: details on which capabilities the sandbox limits, explicit evidence of loading or querying real/public datasets within the sandbox, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-card sandbox experience.
